Subject: Fwd: Fenech Scheduling 
 
Peter's response

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Bhatia, Peter <pbhatia@gannett.com>
Date: Fri, Jul 31, 2020, 1:37 PM
Subject: Re: Fenech Scheduling
To: Stevie Blanchard <stevie@detroitguild22.org>
Just talked to Chris about getting the schedule done per contract.
On Jul 31, 2020, at 1:36 PM, Stevie Blanchard <stevie@detroitguild22.org> wrote:

There is one outstanding issue concerning Anthony’s schedule. He has not been given a two-week schedule. Anthony was told by Chris via email July 20, that he was on the Web Desk and could work remotely.

As of today, Anthony still does not have two-week schedule per the CBA Article V: Section L. Which states “Employees shall be given two (2) weeks' notice by the Publisher of changes in their regular working schedules; provided that changes made necessary by illness or emergencies caused by an employee's inability to work his/her posted schedule may be made on ten (10) hours' notice. Staff shortages resulting from "news breaks" or variations in volume of work shall not be construed as "emergencies". Any employee required to work during hours outside his/her posted schedule (except as hereinbefore provided) shall be compensated for such work at overtime rates or compensatory time."

Since Anthony was told he'd be working remotely on the Web Desk, and should have a schedule through Aug. 14, we request that he be given a two-week schedule where he can work remotely or be compensated at overtime rates for all the time worked outside his posted schedule.

Administrative Officer
Newspaper Guild of Detroit
928-380-0286
